name: House Blend
summary: A dependable, balanced cup with familiar chocolate and caramel character.
why: A comfortable everyday choice that works black or with cream.

name: Brazil Cerrado
summary: Smooth, full and naturally sweet with low acidity.
why: Great when you want body and cocoa flavor without a sharp finish.

name: Tiffany’s Blend
summary: Rich and approachable with sweetness that stands up to milk.
why: A fuller option for drinkers who want a little more depth.

name: Voodoo
summary: Deep, earthy and bold with a darker, more adventurous personality.
why: A strong step outside the familiar for people who enjoy intensity.

name: Morning Light
summary: Clean and lively with gentle sweetness and brighter character.
why: A good bridge into lighter coffee without becoming too sharp.

name: Ironclad
summary: Heavy-bodied and dark enough to hold its own in milk and syrups.
why: Built for people who want unmistakable strength and roast presence.

name: Espresso
summary: Heavy-bodied and dark enough to hold its own in milk and syrups.
why: Built for people who want unmistakable strength and roast presence in their drinks and espresso.
